note: Barron County park on Prairie Lake, part of a chain of five connected lakes. Electric sites 1E-14E line the lake side of the park road, with the water seen through the trees; 10E-14E and 21E-27E can also be rented by the month. Sites 17-20 and 28-30 are tent sites, and 31 is reached on foot or by boat. ATV/UTVs are allowed on the park roads. Boat landing ($5 launch fee) and fish cleaning house. --Claude
summary: County park page, all 29 site pages, 2026 park map, 2026 rules, availability calendars and imagery read. Fees $30 confirmed (+$5 reservation fee, 2 vehicles); booking online, 12-month window, 14 nights; season May 1 - Oct 15 -> May 1 - Sep 30; WATER false -> true (map: all sites but tent sites have water hookups); facilities potable water added. LAKEFRONT -> LAKEVIEW: a continuous tree strip separates the lake-side sites from the shore. PIN move ~330 m north onto the camping road. Phone null -> 715-418-1683. ATV/UTV allowed (flag).
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview. The lake-side row 1E-14E (about 45.3897-45.3915,-91.7170 to -91.7175) sits 35-45 m from Prairie Lake but behind a continuous strip of trees on Esri; the county's own photos of 9E and 10E show the lake only through the trunks beyond the picnic table. No open apron = a view. 1E-9E are sold only by the night; 10E-14E nightly or monthly. Suggested waterfront_evidence: 'Esri 2026-11-16 + county site photos: lake-side sites 1E-14E ~35-45 m from Prairie Lake behind a continuous tree strip; lake visible through trees from 9E/10E; lakeview'.
PIN MOVE ~330 m: stored 45.3876,-91.7180 is on the access road at the slough narrows south of the campground; the camping road with sites 1E-27E is centred at 45.3905,-91.7173.
PHONE: null -> 715-418-1683 (park caretaker, May 1 - Sep 30). Off-season the county lists 715-537-6132.
SEASON: closes 10-15 -> 09-30. 2027: May 1 - Sep 30 (the calendar is closed from Oct 1, and in April).

OHV: 'New for 2025: ATV/UTVs now permitted at county parks' - park roads only, 10 mph, not during quiet hours. A general campground with an ATV allowance, not a staging or trail-system camp. Flag only.

Sites: 29 numbered sites (1E-14E, 17-31; 15&16E are the caretaker's). Stored count 28 matches the drive-in sites (31 is walk-in/boat-in only), left. Electric 21 sites. Sizes 20-25 ft (3E, 27E) to 40+ ft; no exact rig maximum, so max_rig_ft not written. The old note's camper-reported fit line was dropped: the county lists most sites at 30-40+ ft.
Monthly rental: 12 of 21 electric sites (10E-14E, 21E-27E) can be rented monthly but are also sold by the night; the rest are nightly only. Not a long-stay concern for a county park.

Rules PDF: primitive sites at Barron County parks are 'first-come, first-served basis only', but the Veterans Memorial tent sites 17-20 and 28-31 are listed as reservable on the booking site; fcfs not written.
Inclusion evidence says 'May-Sep' and describes this park; it is current. Suggested addition: '21 electric/water sites 20/30/50 A (2026 park map)'.
